decision: Scan-only Temerario-style reel for the GR86 (gen 2); reuse ferrari-296 tools/shot.py, composite.py, logo_card.py and huracan-evo regcheck/hinge ideas
why: Brief: siblings pushed a keyframed shot renderer and composite tools that already implement the house look; reusing them keeps the batch consistent

decision: Hero car = 'BRZ Full Car' (18vYkgpx...), not 'GR86 Full Car'
why: Every Bomex part/state scan registers to the BRZ Full Car raw frame (overlap 49-92 %, median 2.6-5 mm) and has 0 % overlap with GR86 Full Car (different frame); render shows the BRZ horizontal-slat grille. Project dir stays toyota-gr86 per brief

decision: Levelled with tools/level2.py (PCA axes, nose from the Front Bumper Only scan -> -Y, tyre-contact plane -> z=0); one rigid transform for every scan
why: No ground in the BRZ scan: RANSAC ground fit locked onto a door panel and laid the car on its side; tyre contacts are the true ground

decision: Panels: front/rear bumper = Bomex part scans with pinned ICP (xf/*_icp.npy, <=16 mm move); hood = car tris missing from 'Hood Open' + filled top-view mask (tools/hood_mask.py); mirrors = car tris outboard of 'Side Mirrors Removed'
why: Bumper part scans are loose captures (ICP 0.4/1.2 deg); no hood part scan exists and the open hood was not captured, so the car's own hood is the panel; difference-only extraction left holes and fragments

decision: No trunk-open shot; trunk lid not in the exploded set
why: Trunk Open / Trunk Open Bumper Off scans do not capture a usable lid (looked at state renders); extraction was patchy

decision: Exploded set: hood (lifts highest), front bumper, rear bumper; mirrors stay on the car
why: Left mirror in the full-car scan is a thin dark stick (poor capture) - flying it out would show a broken part; right one alone would look lopsided

decision: Explode base fills: Hood Open (engine bay), Bumper Hood Removed below z 650 mm, Rear Bumper Removed, Trunk Open Bumper Off below 750 mm
why: Unlimited fills added half-open hood remnants and the raised trunk lid as floating sheets at the cowl/deck (seen in expl check render)

decision: Shot list: s1 front-right 3/4 low turntable, s2 rear-right 3/4 orbit, s3 headlight/intake close-up (2 mm crop), s4 tail lamp + ducktail close-up (2 mm crop), s5 hood opens 52 deg on its cowl hinge, s6 near top-down with the car turning, s7 explode (hood, front + rear bumper lift into layers above the car and return), logo card
why: Temerario order from the brief; right side because the left mirror is a broken capture; headlight instead of wheel because tyres/spokes are incomplete in the scan (framing checks)
